name: Ray Segment List Generation
aliases: Rasterizing occupancy geometry for ray segments
definition: The process of rasterizing occupancy geometry to create singly-linked lists of ray events per pixel, which define ray segments (intervals between events) with associated occupancy classes.
summary: Ray Segment List Generation converts rasterized occupancy geometry into singly-linked lists of ray events per pixel, distinguishing itself by using a sequential, non-hierarchical traversal that embeds occupancy classes directly in event types.
